composition_subtypes.role: Defines state as depth and shortest path via BFS/DP transitions
Reduces edge iteration to O(n) by skipping previously visited depths using a decreasing bound

payload.core_composition_summary: BFS/DP with amortized range skipping using a monotonically decreasing boundary to achieve O(n) time.
payload.rationale: Implicit DP computes shortest paths; amortized two-pointer technique avoids O(n^2) transitions by ensuring each depth is processed once.
